records.title: Finst — USDC Extends Its Lead Over USDT in a Record Month for Stablecoins
records.note: Reports Visa/Allium adjusted stablecoin transaction volume of $8.82T in H1 2026, with USDC approximately 70% and USDT approximately 25%; June adjusted volume $1.79T. It states Visa removes bot activity, exchange transfers and other transactions not representing real economic activity. This is the source for the H1 70% figure. Cointelegraph's separate July 6 article supports June's $1.79T and USDC's 67% June share; do not attribute the H1 70% figure to Cointelegraph.
